
---
title: "Relatório Cientométrico — IA para previsão de enchentes (costeiras/SC)"
output: html_document
params:
  anos: [2000, 2025]
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## 1. Pacotes e importação

```{r}
# install.packages("bibliometrix")
library(bibliometrix)

# Ajuste os nomes/paths conforme seus arquivos exportados:
paths <- list(
  scopus = "scopus_export_YYYYMMDD.csv",
  wos    = "wos_export_YYYYMMDD.txt",
  openalex = "openalex_export_YYYYMMDD.bib",
  lens   = "lens_export_YYYYMMDD.csv",
  scielo = "scielo_export_YYYYMMDD.ris",
  scholar= "scholar_pop_export_YYYYMMDD.bib"
)

# Carregar somente os que você tiver exportado:
dfs <- list()

if (file.exists(paths$scopus))   dfs$scopus   <- convert2df(paths$scopus, dbsource = "scopus",   format = "csv")
if (file.exists(paths$wos))      dfs$wos      <- convert2df(paths$wos,    dbsource = "wos",      format = "plaintext")
if (file.exists(paths$openalex)) dfs$openalex <- convert2df(paths$openalex, dbsource = "openalex", format = "bibtex")
if (file.exists(paths$lens))     dfs$lens     <- convert2df(paths$lens,   dbsource = "lens",     format = "csv")
if (file.exists(paths$scielo))   dfs$scielo   <- convert2df(paths$scielo, dbsource = "scopus",   format = "ris")
if (file.exists(paths$scholar))  dfs$scholar  <- convert2df(paths$scholar, dbsource = "wos",     format = "bibtex")

length(dfs)
```

## 2. Mesclar bases e remover duplicatas

```{r}
M <- mergeDbSources(dfs, remove.duplicated = TRUE)
# Filtro temporal
yrs <- params$anos
M <- M[M$PY >= yrs[1] & M$PY <= yrs[2], ]
nrow(M)
```

## 3. Análise descritiva

```{r}
res <- biblioAnalysis(M, sep = ";")
S <- summary(res, k = 20, pause = FALSE)
S$MainInformation
```

### Publicações por ano

```{r}
plot(x = res, k = 10, pause = FALSE)
```

## 4. Redes

### Co-palavra (Author Keywords + Keywords Plus)

```{r}
Net_kw <- biblioNetwork(M, analysis = "co-occurrences", network = "keywords", sep = ";")
networkPlot(Net_kw, normalize = "association", type = "fruchterman", n = 50, size = TRUE, labelsize = 0.7)
```

### Co-citação (Referências)

```{r}
Net_ref <- biblioNetwork(M, analysis = "co-citation", network = "references", sep = ";")
networkPlot(Net_ref, type = "fruchterman", n = 50, size = TRUE, labelsize = 0.7)
```

### Acoplamento bibliográfico (Autores)

```{r}
Net_bc <- biblioNetwork(M, analysis = "coupling", network = "authors", sep = ";")
networkPlot(Net_bc, type = "fruchterman", n = 50, size = TRUE, labelsize = 0.7)
```

## 5. Mapa Temático

```{r}
thematicMap(M, field = "ID", minfreq = 5, stemming = FALSE, nLabels = 4)
```
